title: k11 Integration QA MCP Server
description:
MCP server and CI tool for integration testing of event-driven and batch systems as release evidence: flows that combine API calls, Apache Kafka messages (publish, expect with JSON-path matching and time limits, dead-letter queues, AsyncAPI payload checks), batch jobs and database checks, with guardrails that keep publishing and jobs on test environments.

Source code: https://github.com/K11-Software-Solutions/k11techlab-integration-qa-mcp
